fault: The serve did not clear the net.
corrections: The serve did not clear the net. Make contact a little higher and push the racket face through the base of the shuttle towards the target, rather than chopping down on it.
The service went into the net. Raise the contact point and guide the shuttle over the tape with a relaxed forearm instead of stabbing at it.
The serve failed to cross the net. Meet the shuttle higher and keep the racket moving through contact; decelerating at the shuttle is what drops it into the tape.

fault: The serve was hit out of the service court.
corrections: The serve carried past the service line. Shorten the follow-through and let the racket face absorb the pace, so the shuttle peaks before the net and falls onto the front service line.
The service went long. Take pace off the swing and aim to have the shuttle already descending as it crosses the tape.
The serve landed outside the service court. Use a shorter, more controlled push and set the target on the front service line rather than deep.

fault: A front-court shot was played into the net.
corrections: The net shot was played into the net. Take the shuttle earlier and higher, keep the racket head above the hand, and let the racket face carry it over the tape instead of hitting down on it.

This front-court shot did not clear the tape. Lunge so the racket reaches the shuttle in front of the body at a higher contact point, and slow the racket head through contact rather than stopping it dead.
The shuttle was struck into the net at the front of the court. Meet it sooner, with the racket head up, and brush softly upwards across the base of the shuttle.
